entries.title: Dave the Diver
entries.definitive_edition: Dave the Diver on Windows PC with In the Jungle and available content packs; Nintendo Switch Anniversary Edition for Guilty Gear Strive crossover content

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build for the main route; use native Switch hardware for the Anniversary Edition exclusive content.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation for the main route; native Switch presentation for exclusive Anniversary content.

primary.version: Current PC release with In the Jungle and available content packs
primary.why: The Windows PC version is the highest-fidelity and most flexible capture route, with the current main game, In the Jungle DLC, and available content packs. The Switch Anniversary Edition has exclusive Guilty Gear Strive crossover content, so it is tracked as a secondary route.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Dave the Diver on Steam for Windows PC and add In the Jungle plus the available content packs. If you want the Guilty Gear Strive crossover content, also play the Nintendo Switch Anniversary Edition.

secondary.why: The physical Switch Anniversary Edition includes exclusive Guilty Gear Strive crossover content, including themed boat/character content and a rhythm minigame, which is not the standard PC route.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Windows PC release with current DLC/content-pack route.
all_releases.reason: primary: highest-fidelity capture route and current main-content path, including In the Jungle.
skip: same core PC-family route; Windows PC remains the preferred capture/support path.

all_releases.fidelity: Nintendo Switch handheld/TV release; Anniversary Edition includes exclusive Guilty Gear Strive crossover content.
all_releases.reason: secondary: lower-fidelity than PC, but needed for exclusive Guilty Gear Strive crossover content.
skip: console route, but no sourced exclusive content over PC except the Switch-only Anniversary content.
skip: strong console route, but no sourced exclusive content over PC except the Switch-only Anniversary content.

all_releases.fidelity: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition / upgraded Nintendo route.
all_releases.reason: skip: improved Nintendo route, but the cited Guilty Gear Strive exclusive content is tied to the Switch Anniversary Edition.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Windows PC is the best-fidelity current main-content route, but Nintendo Switch Anniversary Edition has exclusive Guilty Gear Strive crossover content. Use PC as the primary playthrough and Switch Anniversary Edition only for that exclusive crossover material.

entries.remaster_caveats: In the Jungle is a major paid content pack released in June 2026. Godzilla and Ichiban crossover packs have been limited-time availability windows, so confirm storefront availability before planning a complete-crossover capture. Switch Anniversary Edition is a physical/special edition with exclusive Guilty Gear Strive content, not a remaster.
